meta.title: Transcript Turbo
meta.description: Keeps long, formula-heavy conversations smooth: offscreen message blocks stop participating in style recalculation and layout, and idle loading animations stop repainting every frame. Measured on a 300+ message, 2900+ formula session: idle main-thread 26-105% down to 1-2%, layout recalcs 155/s down to ~1/s, no typing or scroll regression. Three switches on the plugin detail page apply instantly; one injected stylesheet only — no timers, no listeners — fully removed when disabled, and other plugins' appearance is untouched.
